title: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act Security Rule Technical Controls

controls.title: Encryption and Decryption (Addressable)
controls.description: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information (ePHI) at rest and in transit.

controls.title: Data Backup Plan (Required)
controls.description: Establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of electronic protected health information.

controls.title: Audit Controls (Required)
controls.description: Implement hardware, software, and procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use electronic protected health information.

controls.title: Transmission Security (Addressable)
controls.description: Implement security measures to guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.
